native_metric: Population counts; prevalence; class support; duplicate and split membership
required_control: Declare sampling, prevalence, duplicate policy, split construction, and target role
notes: Metrics inherit the declared population; disjoint membership does not prove absence of every semantic dependency.

native_metric: PR-AUC; ROC-AUC; precision; recall; F1; FPR
required_control: Forward separation where appropriate; ranking/threshold separation; family-composition controls
notes: The five-realization ordering is descriptive and does not identify chronology as the sole mechanism.

native_metric: PR-AUC; ROC-AUC; operating-point metrics; fidelity and agreement diagnostics
required_control: Behavior-restricted comparison; matched-size placebos; depth-one and family-composition controls
notes: Ablation sensitivity is not proof of leakage or a causal transfer mechanism.

native_metric: Direction-specific PR-AUC; ROC-AUC; frozen-threshold metrics; Brier sensitivity
required_control: Declared semantic bridge; separate directions; no target adaptation; preserve cancelled cells
notes: Asymmetric transfer is not averaged; conclusions remain bridge- and target-specific.

native_metric: PPV; NPV; true and false alerts; analyst-hours; required FPR; relative cost
required_control: Frozen TPR/FPR; explicit prevalence, traffic, service-time, capacity, and cost assumptions
notes: Prior-shift outputs are analytic projections, not measured field performance.

native_metric: Latency percentiles; throughput; memory; artifact size; backend status
required_control: Declared hardware/software, batch, timed component, feature-extraction inclusion, and unsupported paths
notes: Measured paths are hardware- and component-specific, not capture-to-alert constants.

checklist_item: 7. Test unseen-family behavior with eligibility controls
native_metric: Family-specific ROC-AUC; PR-AUC; recall and other frozen-threshold metrics; support
required_control: Zero training/validation exposure; day-atomic eligibility; separate learners; descriptive low-support handling
notes: The design evaluates eligible benchmark families and does not define a pooled novelty score.

native_metric: Seed-level PR-AUC; ROC-AUC; operating-point outcomes; means; SDs; directional counts
required_control: Registered seeds; no best-run selection; separate realization spread from bootstrap or target-sampling uncertainty
notes: Finite-seed stability strengthens fixed-recipe conclusions without creating a population guarantee.
